independentAssessment.independentDerivation: Independent left-to-right carry map stores the unmatched position for each value. A repeated incoming value consumes that earlier position and doubles at the current right position, continuing carries until unique. Induction on increasing values: original/doubled tokens of each value are encountered in retained-index order; adjacent pairs are exactly those of the smallest-value-first schedule, and later tokens cannot alter already paired prefixes. Sort final unmatched values by retained position. This differs from worker value/index priority heap.
